pr_body:
Repurposed the already existing `FilenameField` class for use with `ExportFileWindow` and `ExportSpriteSheetWindow`. Fix #4483.

Changes to`FilenameField`:

- Moved most of the path-related logic in `ExportFileWindow` to `FilenameField`.
- Pressing the button now shows a menu with options for choosing a file, and whether to display it as absolute or relative.
- Added the class itself to the switches on `gen/ui_class.cpp` and `app/widget_loader.cpp` so that it can be used in xml files as `<filename />`. The default type is `ButtonAndEntry`, overridden by the xml attribute `button_only`.
- Added a member variable for use with the 'ask overwrite' popup, set to true by default, and then set to false when the file selector is invoked.

Notes:
- There's a small problem with 'filename' in some places refering to the *name* of the file without path (eg: `base::get_file_name()`), while in other places it refers to the full absolute path (`app::Doc::filename`). It's a very minor thing, but leaving it like this could be confusing.
- The new menu shows when `type == ButtonOnly`. I'm not sure whether to disable this or not.
- `FilenameField` could perhaps handle other bits of logic related to file extension.
- `ExportSpriteSheetWindow` used to invoke the 'ask overwrite' popup for both files regardless of whether one of them had already been confirmed for overwrite. Now it will only ask whether to overwrite a file if the corresponding boolean is set to true.
pr_comments: I'll try to rebase this PR to the latest beta to give a try (sorry that I put #4483 targeting main, it should go to beta, I'll change that).

I've changed the target branch to beta, and rebased these commits: https://github.com/dacap/aseprite/tree/show-output-folder (already with clang-format).

I'll try to test a little more. @Liebranca if you update your branch to the rebased version, this PR will be updated automatically (and probably the CI checks will pass)

I've tested a little bit, so far it looks great! I think this will help a lot of newcomers to know and choose the correct output folder.

Some little things to improve:

* I think that by default it should show the relative path (which is the current behavior)
* We should try to save the relative/absolute user preference, not sure where (probably a global option for each field?)
* It looks like the relative path is not displayed correctly if we are in the absolute path, e.g. having

  ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/48e707ec-e679-4765-aacc-1ed846e1268c)

  if we've already exported to each subfolder:

  ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/563e7515-c690-447e-aea0-86e468280f35)

  the menu shows the folder to which we are exporting as Relative Path (and not relative to the folder of the original sprite):

  ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8f3c099e-6c96-418a-8aee-40f0726ae13a)

  but if we select Relative Path, then the field and the menu are correct:

  ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b6c9d4f5-4ab3-4ff4-880a-33c64ea9c32f)

* I didn't fully test a `Dialog:file{}` with scripts yet, but probably we'll need some extra options to customize the field
Hi @dacap! I've added a few things to `Dialog:file{}` to try and better match how `FilenameField` behaves on both of the 'Export As' windows, please let me know if you have any feedback.

@Liebranca great! I'll be reviewing this PR today and tomorrow. I'm trying to rebase the whole PR because it has a conflict with ebc4624d59f0486f9502bfe7b17966473e609908, trying to check where `base::get_absolute_path()` is necessary :thinking:
I was able to test this and it works great @Liebranca! :tada: I'll merge the PR as it is (there are some minor changes in style I'll make in following commits, but nothing major).

issue_context.title: Show / make explicit export location
issue_context.body:
Some recurrent UI inconvenience when we export (File > Export > Export As / Export Sprite Sheet) is to show/select the location where the export will be done.

Final UI:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d95c7030-8a60-4ed4-85e0-1e27c8f10af0)

<details>
<summary>Old prototype</summary>
Some ideas to show the path or {elements}:

![image](https://github.com/aseprite/aseprite/assets/39654/1b82fdb1-1952-4522-bf96-244c0801a9bc)
</details>
comments: @Liebranca saw that you’ve selected this one, contact me next week to see what we can do, some progress was already made in #4389, the mockup in this issue doesn’t solve the main problem that maybe we should attack and might be as simple as just showing the output folder in other field (we’re open to ideas here).

@dacap Yes, I was thinking about having another field too, since a logical division is already there. It's more optimal for both parts to be modified independent of each other, I feel. The question then is how should this division be presented. I'll take note of any ideas.

I think a possible solution to include the Relative/Absolute options is showing a menu when the "..." button is pressed:

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7f8c9f70-6bdd-41df-babe-cdf91140233f)

Where "Choose File" does the current action of just pressing the "..." button. And "Relative Path" / "Absolute Path" changes how the path is displayed in the Entry field. The relative path option could show the folder that is used as reference: `Relative Path to "{}"`

Hi @dacap! I implemented the menu in f481a9c, now I'd like to make a separate widget class to better encapsulate this (filepath entry + '...' button with the menu), so that it can be reused for `ExportSpriteSheetWindow` without duplicating code.

Hi @Liebranca, that'd be nice! You can create a new widget. About your commit, I highly recommend you to create a draft PR (it's easier to test a PR using the [gh](https://cli.github.com/) CLI tool for me).
